item.title: Aldi to open 40 new UK stores in 2026 as part of £370m expansion
item.description: Aldi plans to open 40 new UK stores in 2026 under a £370m investment, targeting towns without an Aldi as it works towards a long-term goal of 1,500 locations. Read more: Aldi to open 40 new UK stores in 2026 as part of £370m expansion

item.title: Ministers again reject Waspi compensation claims after fresh review
item.description: Ministers have again ruled out compensation for women affected by state pension age changes, despite a fresh review, prompting fury from the Waspi campaign and opposition MPs. Read more: Ministers again reject Waspi compensation claims after fresh review

item.title: Implementation of the Employment Rights Act 2025: what employers need to know
item.description: The Employment Rights Act 2025 received Royal Assent on 18 December 2025, and the Act will be implemented on a phased basis, through to 2027. Read more: Implementation of the Employment Rights Act 2025: what employers need to know

item.title: China to allow visa-free travel for British visitors as UK seeks closer trade ties
item.description: China will allow British citizens to travel visa-free for up to 30 days after talks between Prime Minister Keir Starmer and President Xi Jinping, as the UK looks to boost trade and services exports. Read more: China to allow visa-free travel for British visitors as UK seeks closer trade ties

item.title: Tesla axes Model S and X as revenues fall and focus shifts to AI and robotics
item.description: Tesla has reported its first annual revenue decline as it cuts the Model S and Model X, pivots manufacturing to humanoid robots and deepens investment in AI. Read more: Tesla axes Model S and X as revenues fall and focus shifts to AI and robotics

item.title: Apple posts record iPhone sales as Mac revenues fall
item.description: Apple has reported its best-ever iPhone sales in the final quarter of 2025, lifting overall revenues to $144bn, although Mac and wearables sales declined. Read more: Apple posts record iPhone sales as Mac revenues fall

item.title: UK bans Coinbase adverts that suggested crypto could ease cost-of-living pressures
item.description: The UK’s advertising watchdog has banned Coinbase adverts that implied cryptocurrency could help address cost-of-living concerns, ruling they trivialised the risks of crypto investing. Read more: UK bans Coinbase adverts that suggested crypto could ease cost-of-living pressures

item.title: Driverless taxis could hit UK roads as early as September, Waymo says
item.description: Waymo says it hopes to launch a driverless robotaxi service in London as early as September, ahead of planned UK regulatory changes to allow autonomous taxis. Read more: Driverless taxis could hit UK roads as early as September, Waymo says

item.title: Octopus Energy strikes major China joint venture during PM visit
item.description: Octopus Energy has announced a new joint venture with China’s PCG Power to trade renewable energy, aiming to handle up to 140TWh a year by 2030 and export British energy technology into the world’s largest clean power market. Read more: Octopus Energy strikes major China joint venture during PM visit

item.title: Lloyds to return £3.1bn to investors as profits surge past forecasts
item.description: Lloyds Banking Group will return more than £3.1bn to shareholders through dividends and buybacks after posting stronger-than-expected profits of £6.66bn. Read more: Lloyds to return £3.1bn to investors as profits surge past forecasts
